title: Verify Shutdown Staging Mapping Using ShutDownStaging Table (with tote vs without tote) and Sequence
summary: Use the Robotics database model’s ShutDownStaging mapping to verify where AGVs should stage during shutdown, including the difference between AGVs with totes (off-the-end queue + center queue staging) versus AGVs without totes (mapped to sorter locations). Confirm how the ShutDownStaging Sequence value is used to match an AGV’s zone/sequence to the correct shutdown queue destination.
when_to_use: When you need to diagnose/verify shutdown staging behavior by checking the ShutDownStaging table mapping logic (tote vs without tote) and confirming the Sequence-based mapping used to select the shutdown queue destination.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to make configuration changes or to attempt to correct staging behavior solely by editing the mapping; use it for diagnosis/verification only.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: View the ShutDownStaging table in the Robotics database model and verify tote vs without-tote staging mapping and Sequence-based queue selection logic.
access_or_tools_needed: Robotics database access to view the ShutDownStaging table (SSMS/Helix/WCS DB access as applicable in the environment)

access_required: Robotics database access to view ShutDownStaging

steps.title: Open the ShutDownStaging table in the Robotics database model
steps.purpose: Get visibility into the ShutDownStaging mapping fields needed to verify tote vs without-tote staging and Sequence-based queue selection.
steps.instruction: In the Robotics database model (via SSMS/Helix/WCS DB access as applicable), open the ShutDownStaging table view that includes the mapping columns referenced in the source: ShutDownOffTheEndid, ShutDownQueueId, Sequence, SorterSide, and DatabaseModelid.
steps.expected_result: You can view ShutDownStaging rows with the mapping columns ShutDownOffTheEndid, ShutDownQueueId, Sequence, SorterSide, and DatabaseModelid visible in the table.
steps.healthy_condition: The ShutDownStaging table view loads successfully and shows the expected mapping columns (including Sequence) so you can read values for specific entries.
steps.failure_condition: The ShutDownStaging table does not load, or the expected mapping columns (e.g., Sequence / ShutDownQueueId / ShutDownOffTheEndid) are missing or unreadable.

actions.label: Open ShutDownStaging table view
actions.exact_action: Open the ShutDownStaging table shown in the robotics database model.

stop_or_escalate_if: If ShutDownStaging does not show the expected mapping columns (including Sequence), stop and escalate to deeper database/config troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The shutdown staging table maps where AGVs should go during a shutdown state; the mapping includes fields such as ShutDownOffTheEndid, ShutDownQueueId, Sequence, SorterSide, and DatabaseModelid.

steps.title: Identify tote-carrying AGV staging entries (off-the-end queue + center queue staging)
steps.purpose: Verify that the ShutDownStaging mapping includes the tote-specific staging path: off-the-end queue and a center queue staging destination.
steps.instruction: In the ShutDownStaging table, locate the rows/entries that correspond to AGVs with totes. Confirm that the mapping includes a ShutDownOffTheEndid (off-the-end queue) and a ShutDownQueueId (queue to stage at) for those tote-carrying entries.
steps.expected_result: You can point to ShutDownStaging entries for tote-carrying AGVs where ShutDownOffTheEndid is present (off-the-end queue) and ShutDownQueueId indicates the queue destination to stage at (center queue staging).
steps.healthy_condition: Tote-carrying entries show the off-the-end queue mapping via ShutDownOffTheEndid and also show a ShutDownQueueId destination for staging.
steps.failure_condition: The ShutDownStaging table does not show the expected tote-related pattern (off-the-end queue via ShutDownOffTheEndid and a center queue staging destination via ShutDownQueueId).

actions.label: Confirm tote mapping fields
actions.exact_action: Confirm the mapping includes a ShutDownOffTheEndid (off-the-end queue) and a ShutDownQueueId (queue to stage at).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the ShutDownStaging table does not show the expected tote vs without-tote mapping pattern, stop and escalate to deeper database/config troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGVs with totes have an off the end queue and a queue in the center to stage at.

steps.title: Identify without-tote AGV staging entries (mapped to sorter locations)
steps.purpose: Verify that the ShutDownStaging mapping routes AGVs without totes to sorter locations rather than the tote off-the-end queue path.
steps.instruction: In the ShutDownStaging table, locate the rows/entries that correspond to AGVs without totes. Confirm that the mapping indicates AGVs are mapped to sorter locations (i.e., the destination is based on sorter locations rather than the off-the-end queue path).
steps.expected_result: You can identify ShutDownStaging entries for AGVs without totes where the mapping pattern aligns with 'mapped to sorter locations' rather than the tote off-the-end queue staging path.
steps.healthy_condition: Without-tote entries follow the source-described pattern: they are mapped to sorter locations for shutdown staging.
steps.failure_condition: The ShutDownStaging table does not show the expected without-tote mapping pattern (mapped to sorter locations).

actions.label: Confirm without-tote mapping pattern
actions.exact_action: Confirm the mapping indicates AGVs without totes are mapped to sorter locations.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the ShutDownStaging table does not show the expected tote vs without-tote mapping pattern, stop and escalate to deeper database/config troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGVs without totes are mapped to sorter locations.

steps.title: Locate and verify Sequence values used for shutdown queue selection
steps.purpose: Confirm how the ShutDownStaging Sequence field values are used to select the correct shutdown queue destination based on zone/sequence matching.
steps.instruction: In the ShutDownStaging table, locate the Sequence field values for the relevant tote and without-tote entries. Verify the source rule: Sequence is used as the order to match an AGV’s zone/sequence to the shutdown queue sequence.
steps.expected_result: You can identify Sequence values in ShutDownStaging entries and explain (from what is visible in the table) how those Sequence values correspond to the shutdown queue selection logic described by the source.
steps.healthy_condition: Sequence values are present and readable in the ShutDownStaging table for the entries you are validating.
steps.failure_condition: Sequence field values are missing/unreadable in the ShutDownStaging table.

actions.label: Read Sequence values
actions.exact_action: Locate and note the 'Sequence' field values for the relevant entries.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Sequence field is missing/unreadable, stop and escalate to deeper database/config troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source explains that 'sequence' is an order used to map an AGV's zone/sequence to the shutdown queue sequence.

steps.title: Cross-check the described zone/sequence -> shutdown queue mapping behavior
steps.purpose: Validate that the ShutDownStaging Sequence mapping aligns with the source-described behavior for shutdown staging selection (example: zone 4 -> sequence 4 -> mapped station/destination).
steps.instruction: Using the source-described logic, cross-check the ShutDownStaging entries you identified by Sequence: when an AGV in a given zone triggers shutdown, it looks up the shutdown queue destination using the matching sequence number (e.g., zone 4 uses sequence 4). Confirm that the Sequence value you see in ShutDownStaging maps to the expected shutdown queue destination (via the table’s mapping fields).
steps.expected_result: The ShutDownStaging entries you identified show a consistent mapping where the Sequence value used for zone/sequence matching corresponds to the shutdown queue destination selection described by the source.
steps.healthy_condition: For the zone/sequence example described by the source, the ShutDownStaging Sequence value you locate corresponds to a shutdown queue destination mapping that matches the described lookup behavior.
steps.failure_condition: The ShutDownStaging Sequence-based mapping does not align with the source-described zone/sequence -> shutdown queue selection behavior.

actions.label: Cross-check Sequence-based mapping
actions.exact_action: Cross-check the source-described behavior: zone/sequence matching selects the shutdown queue destination using the same sequence number.
